primary_sources.summary: GMA documents automatic collection and sharing of IP-derived general location, interactions, diagnostics and identifiers for advertising, analytics and fraud prevention. Blocking Android ad ID alone does not establish that other data stops.

SDK transfers count. IP-derived approximate location must be declared. Optional requires a choice for every user/device/region and every distributed version. Service-provider or user-initiated sharing exceptions require their conditions. Ephemeral requires real-time-only memory processing; retained logs or profiling do not qualify. Social graph is Contacts.

Google lists possible IP/coarse location, non-user-related crash logs, user-associated performance, device identifiers, advertising data and interactions. It identifies advertising/analytics uses and requires checking actual SDK privacy manifests and mediation partners.

Disclose developer and integrated partner collection. Ongoing optional collection is still disclosed. Contacts includes social graph. Linked and tracking are separate; tracking involves cross-company advertising/measurement linkage or data brokers. Apple-only framework collection is not automatically developer collection.

Current terms effective March 23, 2026 distinguish unpaid and paid handling. Unpaid may allow model improvement and human review; sensitive personal data must not be submitted there. Paid API treatment requires the actual API project to have active Cloud Billing and permits limited abuse/safety logging under the processor terms; it does not prove zero retention. Clinical practice and medical advice are prohibited; wellness-only boundaries still require behavior evidence.
